title: 第一卷 第5章 你拿去还债吧
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
一行人来到码头。

    码头虽然在两个村子之间，也是两个村子的渔在使用，但其实是张春妮所在的白沙村修建。

    因此。

    白沙村的村民颇有微词，偶有摩擦。

    这码头收购海货的摊贩，都是白沙村的人，他们村子的收购摊贩只能在自己村子靠近海边的位置搞个收购点。

    这个点的码头，尤其是做生意的一排平房前，人还挺多，热热闹闹。

    没一会。

    几人停在一处门面房前。

    张春妮正犹豫着要不要走过来，等李华回头看了她一眼，她就低着头，老老实实的走到跟前。

    刘表偷偷的看了张春妮一眼，“好心”的解释道：“我们经常和老陈打交道，以前华哥偷人海鲜，都是他收。”

    张春妮小声解释：“这……这些不是偷的。”

    刘表还想说话，李华打断，让刘表赶紧去招呼老陈出来。

    刘表走进门面房，去后院喊人。

    阿青问道：“华哥，这些能卖不少钱吧。”

    李华：“应该吧。”

    海鲜的价格不是固定的。

    会随着市场需求而发生改变。

    也有淡季和旺季，比如梭子蟹大量上市的时候，价格会比平时低很多。

    这些年。

    海洋资源日益匮乏，再加上冷鲜技术提升，运输渠道打开，海鲜的价格持续走高，渔民的日子也要比以前好过很多。

    只要不懒，家里没啥灾祸，钱总归是能不少赚。

    靠山吃山，靠水吃水。

    有这得天独厚的资源，李华觉得没必要舍近求远，在这小渔村打拼，就足以实现财富自由，享受春暖花开面朝大海的生活。

    老陈走出来，笑着招呼道：“阿华来啦。”

    “嚯，这小半桶蛏子，还有三个青蟹。”

    “可值不少钱，不是之前那三瓜俩枣的，风险有点大啊。”

    看到这一桶的海鲜，他挪不开眼了。

    李华说道：“别说那些没用的，这些海货是我亲手从滩涂地抓的，你给个实在的市场价。”

    老陈嗤笑：“谁信啊。”

    阿青说道：“是真的。”

    刘表也跟着喊道：“我也可以作证。”

    老陈还是不信：“咱也不是第一天打交道，这些货，我给你们一百块钱。”

    “也不少了，够你们哥三喝顿好的。”

    李华说道：“老陈，你这就不厚道了。”

    老陈冷笑：“实话实说，这码头除了我，谁敢收你的货？”

    “一句话，卖不卖，不卖就滚。”

    他说的很不客气，对个烂仔，不需要摆什么好脸色，能搞一笔最好，不能也无所谓，他也没胡咧咧，的确是要担风险的，万一苦主来闹，他还要想办法平事。
content_en:
A group of people arrived at the dock.

    Although the pier is between the two villages and is used by fishermen from the two villages, it was actually built by Baisha Village, where Zhang Chuni lives.

    therefore.

    The villagers in Baisha Village had quite a few complaints and occasionally had conflicts.

    The vendors who purchase seafood at this pier are all from Baisha Village. The vendors in their village can only set up a purchase point in their village near the seaside.

    The pier at this point, especially in front of the row of bungalows where businesses are located, is quite crowded and lively.

    Not a moment.

    Several people stopped in front of a front house.

    Zhang Chuni was hesitating whether to come over. When Li Hua turned around and glanced at her, she lowered her head and walked up to him honestly.

    Liu Biao glanced at Zhang Chuni secretly and explained "kindly": "We often deal with Lao Chen. In the past, Brother Hua stole seafood from others and he always collected it."

    Zhang Chuni explained in a low voice: "This...these are not stolen."

    Liu Biao still wanted to speak, but Li Hua interrupted and asked Liu Biao to quickly call Lao Chen out.

    Liu Biao walked into the front room and went to the backyard to call someone.

    Ah Qing asked: "Brother Hua, these can be sold for a lot of money."

    Li Hua: "Probably."

    The price of seafood is not fixed.

    Will change with market demand.

    There are also off-seasons and peak seasons. For example, when swimming crabs are on the market in large quantities, the price will be much lower than usual.

    these years.

    Marine resources are increasingly scarce. Coupled with the improvement of cold-fresh technology and the opening of transportation channels, the price of seafood continues to rise, and fishermen's lives are much better than before.

    As long as you are not lazy and there are no disasters at home, you can always make a lot of money.

    You can rely on mountains to eat mountains, and you can rely on water to eat water.

    With such unique resources, Li Hua felt that there was no need to look far away. Working hard in this small fishing village was enough to achieve financial freedom and enjoy a life of blooming spring flowers and facing the sea.

    Lao Chen came out and greeted with a smile: "Ahua is here."

    "Hey, this is half a bucket of razor clams and three blue crabs."

    "It's worth a lot of money. It's not like the three melons and two dates before. The risk is a bit high."

    Seeing this bucket of seafood, he couldn't move his eyes away.

    Li Hua said: "Don't talk about those useless things. I caught these seafood from the tidal flats with my own hands. Please give me a real market price."

    Old Chen sneered: "Who believes it?"

    Ah Qing said: "It's true."

    Liu Biao also shouted: "I can also testify."

    Lao Chen still didn't believe it: "This is not the first day we have dealt with each other. I will give you a hundred yuan for these goods."

    "It's quite a lot, enough for your brother to have a good meal."

    Li Hua said: "Old Chen, you are not being kind."

    Old Chen sneered: "To be honest, who else dares to accept your goods at this dock except me?"

    "In a word, sell it or not. If you don't sell it, get out."

    He said it very rudely. There was no need to put on a good face when dealing with a bad boy. It was the best deal if he could, and it didn't matter if he couldn't. He was not careless. He did have to take risks. If the mistress came to make trouble, he had to find a way to make things right.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 5 You can use it to pay off your debts
